programmes.d: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon.

From big and energetic cities to beautiful small villages, Quebec has it all. A stunning coastline and amazing food, but more than anything else, pristine wilderness. The Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region boasts three national parks and a dramatic Saguenay Fjord.

Montreal is a historic and multicultural place that pulses with energy. What makes it particularly amazing is that it also provides easy access to outdoor activities and world-class paddling opportunities, both inside and outside city limits.

This year’s anticipated 2017 ISA World Adaptive Surfing Championship will be held in sunny San Diego in the renown La Jolla neighborhood. The physically challenged surfers participate in teams of up to eight members, and represent their home countries as they race through the waters.
The Formula Windsurfing Junior Youth & Masters European Championship 2013 was held in the stunning Azores archipelago.

Matt Bromley is a renowned big wave surfer. Ollie Swart is a chef. Together, the two best friends will embark on an adventure down Cape Town’s coastline. Foraging for food and looking for the best surf spots, Surf’s Cooking brings gastronomy to the surfing world with this beautiful friendship.

In this episode, Andi will discover the diverse marine ecosystem of Kilifi Creek. She will learn how to sail in three days in order to truly experience the creek. Andi goes 3 degrees south to meet Kevin, a local sailor who patiently teaches Andi the skills she needs in this short span of time.

One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever.

Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of  Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island.

In this first episode of Road to Bermuda we meet the man who decided to take the America's Cup to Bermuda and explore some of sailing's most complex challenges. Also, the famous skipper Jimmy Spithill will share his experience on the island with us. Watch this and more on The Road to Bermuda.

Ready for the best weekend of your lives? The SXM Best Weekend is one of the most anticipated Caribbean summer events of the year. A local group of young brothers and musicians called “The Red Eye Crew” decided to revolutionize the party scenario in these paradisiac islands.

In this episode, we are travelling to the other side of the world for the second act of the Kitefoil World Series to see if Toni Vodisek can keep up with his great performance beating and second fleet after Gizzeria.
In this episode we are taking a domestic flight to the east coast of Fujian Province, Pingtan, for the Kitefoil World Series.
